content: {"conclusions":[{"claim":"The sweep is incomplete and unbalanced, so it cannot support full-grid policy rankings.","evidence":"Opening paragraph: 9,816 episodes, 1,636 matched traces, 56 of 288 settings, only base usage 4 units/day, and unequal completed seeds.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether to publish comparative policy conclusions now or wait for the full balanced sweep.","caveat":"The snapshot is not representative of the planned grid; trace-weighted averages and unequal seeds can distort comparisons."},{"claim":"The simulator contains constructed cases where immediate ordering and windowed ordering each outperform the other.","evidence":"Second paragraph: initial stock 2/target 10 case gives 1 versus 4 stockout product-hours; temporary removal of 10 units gives 10 unnecessary units versus 0.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether the policy design must retain both immediate and reassessment-at-window behavior.","caveat":"These are hand-built, noise-free test-suite constructions, not measured episodes or evidence about real kitchen demand."},{"claim":"In one completed diagnostic setting, daily windows substantially increased stockouts while reducing orders and excess purchasing.","evidence":"Third paragraph, setting 18e105cc2b1c6b03: +295.03 stockout product-hours per 14-day episode, approximate paired interval 272.28–317.78, −6.23 supplier orders/week, and −132.59 excess ordered units across 32 seeds.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Choosing the stockout/review trade-off and evaluating daily windows under approval delay and delivery jitter.","caveat":"The setting was selected after inspection, the interval is not selection-adjusted, and the result covers only one synthetic configuration."},{"claim":"Snapshot averages descriptively show higher stockouts for windows and fewer supplier baskets, but do not establish a controlled policy ranking.","evidence":"Fourth paragraph: stockout means 57.72/177.42/127.50 and baskets/week 10.77/5.04/6.80 for immediate/window/window-plus-urgent; averages use available trace checkpoints and mix urgent authority on and off.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Whether these averages may appear in the pitch or should be replaced by per-setting paired comparisons.","caveat":"The numbers are unbalanced and the urgent average mixes different authority regimes; they should not be presented as like-for-like treatment effects."},{"claim":"Zero simulated duplicate and timing/authority violations is only a model sanity result.","evidence":"Fifth paragraph: all observed violation counts are zero, attributed to pending-order and permission guards in the simulated controllers.","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"What robustness claims the demo may make and whether the deployed gateway needs separate fault-injection tests.","caveat":"The zero counts are synthetic observations, while the explanation that guards enforce the behavior is an implemented-code claim requiring coordinator verification; neither tests the live gateway."},{"claim":"A limited reproducibility check succeeded.","evidence":"Fifth paragraph: one downloaded cloud trace regenerated locally with all six complete policy results and trace hash matching; tiny cloud batch 36/36 episodes; 41 local tests passed.","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"How much confidence to place in simulator reproducibility and whether to cite the test suite in the engineering narrative.","caveat":"One trace, a tiny batch, and local unit tests do not validate the full sweep, model realism, deployed gateway, camera, or UNO Q."},{"claim":"The results support a trade-off, not a universally superior replenishment policy.","evidence":"Interpretation paragraph: consolidation can reduce fragmentation and over-ordering, while windows, late approvals, and fresh-evidence requirements can prolong shortages; 'There is no universal winner in these results.'","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Whether to propose configurable windows, cutoffs, urgent authority, and human-review thresholds rather than one fixed policy.","caveat":"The qualitative interpretation is plausible within the model, but the incomplete snapshot does not quantify the trade-off across the full grid or isolate every claimed mechanism."},{"claim":"Several consequential model choices limit operational and production interpretation.","evidence":"Penultimate paragraph: strict delivery-receipt settlement rather than live camera-based C2 pending-clear, optimistic exact human counts, hourly confirmation, eventual delivery of partial remainders, and no spoilage, expiry, cancellation, budget, or price constraints; fees and timing parameters are ASSUMPTION.","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Which sensitivity runs and backend-alignment changes are required before using results to configure the proposal.","caveat":"These assumptions can materially change both stockout and ordering rankings, especially settlement, observation error, and delivery behavior."},{"claim":"The work provides no evidence of real demand, product recognition, UNO Q performance, Valio delivery timing, or production suitability.","evidence":"Opening paragraph: 'No inference here establishes real kitchen demand, camera accuracy, Valio delivery timing, or production suitability'; penultimate paragraph also states that historical quantity fulfilment reliability is not treated as an on-time probability.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Keeping simulator claims separate from the shelf-box demo and defining the remaining real-shelf validation work.","caveat":"No validated recordings of the team's real shelf products exist, so neither synthetic episodes nor public/vendor material could fill this gap."},{"claim":"The replenishment proposal remains a pending team decision rather than an agreed deployed capability.","evidence":"Penultimate paragraph: 'The proposal remains pending team agreement.'","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"How the coordinator should describe autonomy, scheduled ordering, and demo scope to judges.","caveat":"Simulated behavior must not be described as an implemented or validated replenishment service."}],"unsupported_or_overstated":["'Across the incomplete snapshot, the same tension appears' goes beyond a controlled finding if read as a general policy ranking: the averages are checkpoint-weighted, unbalanced, and mix urgent authority settings.","'An urgent path can reduce the delay' is not demonstrated by a controlled comparison in the reported snapshot; the aggregate urgent mean mixes authority on and off, so the claim should be framed as model logic pending per-setting analysis.","'All observed duplicate and timing/authority violation counts are zero because the simulated controllers enforce pending-order and permission guards' combines observed synthetic zeros with an unverified causal code-claim; it provides no evidence about the deployed gateway.","'Final tables are generated automatically on the Volume after all workers finish' is a code-claim about unfinished automation, not a verified result in this output.","'Consolidation can reduce fragmentation and over-ordering' must remain explicitly synthetic; it does not establish reduced fragmentation, cost, or over-ordering in Valio Aimo operations.","Any reuse of these findings as evidence of recognition of the team's shelf products, camera accuracy, or performance on the Arduino UNO Q would be unsupported; the source itself correctly disclaims those inferences."],"repetitive_or_low_value":["Drop Modal detachment, Volume output location, dashboard/function-call/resume/billing pointers, and other run-operations detail from the team summary; retain them only in reproduction documentation.","Consolidate the repeated warnings that the snapshot is incomplete, unbalanced, and not a full-grid result into one prominent qualification.","Move the artifact filename list and exact cloud path to an appendix; keep only the setting ID and paired CSV pointer needed to verify the headline diagnostic result.","Keep the 36/36 cloud batch and 41-test count out of the main policy narrative; they are minor reproducibility details and can be misread as validation of realism.","Do not repeat both aggregate means and the diagnostic setting as equally strong evidence; the team summary should prioritize the controlled per-setting result and label the aggregates exploratory."],"negative_results":["In setting 18e105cc2b1c6b03, the daily window added 295.03 stockout product-hours per 14-day episode despite reducing supplier orders and excess units.","The exploratory snapshot shows substantially higher mean stockout product-hours for windowed ordering than immediate ordering, although the comparison is unbalanced.","The urgent-policy aggregate does not cleanly demonstrate benefit because it mixes authority on and off and remains above the immediate-policy stockout average.","No universal winning policy was found within the reported synthetic results.","Zero simulated violations do not reveal deployed-gateway defects and cannot be used as robustness evidence for the live system.","Only 56 of 288 settings are represented, all at base usage 4 units/day, so most of the intended experimental space remains unreported.","The simulator does not establish real kitchen demand, recognition errors, camera accuracy, UNO Q performance, Valio delivery timing, or production suitability.","Strict receipt settlement differs from the live backend's camera-based C2 pending-clear heuristic, leaving a material simulator/backend mismatch."],"open_question_worth_a_run":["Complete the planned 288-setting sweep with equal seeds per setting, then run pre-specified paired comparisons of immediate, window, and window-plus-urgent policies with urgent authority held fixed within each comparison. Report stockout product-hours, unserved units, baskets/week, excess units, and paired intervals by setting; do not select headline settings after inspecting outcomes.","Run a paired sensitivity experiment on the diagnostic setting plus a small pre-specified set of contrasting configurations, crossing strict receipt settlement with the live C2 pending-clear heuristic and exact counts/hourly confirmation with explicit observation-error and confirmation-delay scenarios. This would test whether the window/urgent conclusions survive the largest model assumptions, without claiming real-shelf accuracy."]}
